items.excerpt: VirtualDJ 2026 gets its third and final update: ShoutOut custom voiceovers, AI scripting ('Vibescripting'), and improved controller and streaming support.
A Japanese actor and anime voice talent has filed suit against TikTok over videos allegedly featuring an AI clone of his iconic voice.
Musixmatch CEO Max Ciociola says lyrics are becoming 'the LLM of the music industry'; the company struck a deal with Suno for a copyright-detection tool called Sentinel.
ClassicalBot uses AI to map classical-music concerts, starting in the developer's home country before expanding worldwide.
Oliver Torr (Glazmo Network) mangles Ableton Live tempos with MIRA and assembles drum kits out of AI-surfed YouTube 'slop' in new experimental tools.
Suno confirms its v6 models were trained on user-generated interactions as Sony and UMG file new copyright lawsuits barely a week after the release.
Andrew Huang video: 'AI scammers are trying to use me' — the producer flags AI-driven scams exploiting his name (details in video; unverified beyond title).
Tim Exile's algorithmic (explicitly AI-free) auto-mixing tool Finalist 2 leaves Reaktor for a standalone app and browser, with one-click export, 64 stems and group stem bounces.
Michael Smith, who made $8m streaming AI-generated songs with bots, asks for no prison time, arguing the losses were 'tiny, immeasurable' per artist.
Lunacy Audio launches NOVA, a free browser-based AI-powered platform for building and sharing plugins, with premium tiers for more tools.
Suno subscribers are cancelling after the label-partnered v6 release, calling the output muffled and generic and objecting to new download caps.
SubmitHub bans AI-generated music submissions under a new policy, even at the cost of up to 10% of its current revenue.
Audio Programmer meetup recording: 'Does Coding Matter Anymore? Audio Programming in the AI Age' — audio developers discuss AI's effect on plugin/DSP work.
Suno official YouTube short promoting Suno Studio ('Sometimes you know exactly what you want'); thin, low priority.
